title: Hue Ruqsat Jaha se Hydere Karrar Wawaila
body:
Hue rukhsat jahan se Hyder-e-karar wawaila, laho roote hain kufe ke dar-o-deewar wawaila
Mahina bhi khuda ka ghar bhi zikr bhi uska, namazi ne hai khayi zulm ki talwar wawaila
Ali par zulm kaisa ho gaya Allah ke ghar mein, zara dekheintoaakar Ahmed-e-muqtar wawaila
Fizayen rooti hain aur hai zameen-o-asmaan giryan, qiyamat ke numayan aaj hai aasa wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Hassan roomal kaste hai Ali ke sar pa rorokar, Hussain ibne Ali kehte hain ye har bar wawaila
Tasalli deti hain umm-ul-baneen Abbas ko paiham, magar kamsin labaon par uske hai har bar wawaila
Shahadat par Ali ki aur kya likhon rasheed aakhir, ho hare qisr-e-alam mustafa maseemar wawaila..
